context: This criteria evaluates how effectively the engineer uses @json-render/core package APIs to implement a conditional dashboard system. The evaluation focuses exclusively on correct usage of visibility conditions, actions, validation, and catalog creation features provided by the package.

checklist.name: Catalog Creation
checklist.description: Uses createCatalog function to define component catalog with proper Zod schemas for each component's props (AdminPanel, PremiumSection, Button, EmailInput)

checklist.name: Complex Visibility Logic
checklist.description: Implements admin panel visibility using 'and' and 'or' logic expressions combined with auth condition ({ auth: 'signedIn' }) and comparison operators ({ eq } for role check, { gte } for permission level)

checklist.name: Dynamic Path Comparison
checklist.description: Implements premium section visibility using { gte } comparison with two dynamic path references ({ path: '/user/subscriptionTier' } and { path: '/config/premiumTierRequired' })

checklist.name: Action Parameter Resolution
checklist.description: Configures delete button action with dynamic parameter using { path: '/user/id' } in the action params object

checklist.name: String Interpolation
checklist.description: Uses string interpolation syntax ${/user/name} or ${/path} in the confirmation message property of the action

checklist.name: Action Callbacks
checklist.description: Implements onSuccess callback with navigate property set to '/logout' and onError callback with set property containing error path mapping

checklist.name: Conditional Validation
checklist.description: Configures email validation with enabled property containing a logic expression that references { path: '/ui/changeEmail' }

checklist.name: Validation Functions
checklist.description: Uses built-in validation functions (required and email) in the checks array of the validation config
